data.title: Strategy's Bitcoin Per Share Falls 3.7%: Rapid Earnings Reaction
data.description: Strategy reported a $19.5 billion profit, but nearly all of it came from bitcoin’s price, not the business. Here’s why bitcoin per share is the number to watch, and why it’s shrinking.
